cohort: 758 women who sustained an OASIS between November 2005 and March 2010 and had a subsequent pregnancy
finding: The rate of recurrent OASIS in a subsequent vaginal delivery was 3.2%, with significant risk factors being operative vaginal delivery and birth weight of 4000 g or greater.
mod_finding: Operative vaginal deliveries (forceps-assisted 25%, vacuum-assisted 12.5%) were a significant risk factor for recurrent OASIS compared to spontaneous deliveries (2.7%).
